evals.prompt: What failed on Studio Kanslia Website in the last 24 hours?
evals.expected_output: rfhub_failures with project and from=-24h; compact; no log.html scrape.
assertions: Names rfhub_failures as the tool to list what failed
Scopes the query by project and a -24h time window
Does not fabricate specific failed test names or error messages

evals.prompt: Is test_id e50183be-efa8-4f91-b27f-9a70ab1d29db flaky? Show repeating errors.
evals.expected_output: rfhub_metrics_test then run_log only if excerpt needed.
assertions: Names rfhub_metrics_test as the primary check for flakiness (flips, repeating errors)
Keeps rfhub_run_log as a follow-up only when the metrics excerpt is not enough
Does not open log.html or report.html as the primary evidence
